title: MIDAS RIN List Response (v2.0)
description: Response from the ValueData endpoint when queried with SignalType alone. v2.0 (2026-06-22) replaces the v1.0 bare array of RinListEntry with a single-keyed object whose key reflects the requested SignalType: SignalType=1 → 'Rates', SignalType=2 → 'GHGEmissions', SignalType=3 → 'FlexAlerts', SignalType=0 → 'All'. Exactly one key is present.

All.description: All active RINs across every signal type (SignalType=0). Replaces the removed HistoricalList endpoint.
